answer: Give every new agent a slow voyage from zero trust to full weight. It starts with a small stake locked in an onyx registry that no one can edit in secret, and it earns voting power only after finishing real jobs on time. Sybils can still spawn, but each copy has to repeat the same slow climb, and at dawn of each epoch the registry publishes who earned what, so a hundred fresh clones stay worth less than one agent with a year of delivered work.
